import torch,json,pathlib
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'historical-codex-workspace');from runtime_guard import apply_guard
print(json.dumps({'guard':apply_guard()}),flush=True)
torch.set_num_threads(4)
root=pathlib.Path('historical-codex-models/round02/pairs');manifest=json.loads((root/'manifest.json').read_text());classes=torch.zeros(1000,dtype=torch.long);tokens=torch.zeros(4096,dtype=torch.long);noise_sum=0.;noise_sq_sum=0.;elements=0;seen=0;all_finite=True
for shard in manifest['shards']:
 data=torch.load(root/shard['file'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
 n=data['noise'];ids=data['tokens'].long();labels=data['labels'];all_finite=all_finite and bool(n.isfinite().all());assert ((ids>=0)&(ids<4096)).all()
 classes+=torch.bincount(labels,minlength=1000);tokens+=torch.bincount(ids.flatten(),minlength=4096);noise_sum+=float(n.double().sum());noise_sq_sum+=float(n.double().square().sum());elements+=n.numel();seen+=len(labels)

print(json.dumps({'sample_count':seen,'noise_shape_per_pair':[680,32],'noise_finite':all_finite,'noise_mean':mean,'noise_std':std,'classes_present':int((classes>0).sum()),'classes_missing':torch.where(classes==0)[0].tolist(),'class_count_min':int(classes.min()),'class_count_max':int(classes.max()),'class_count_histogram':torch.bincount(classes).tolist(),'codebook_entries_used':int((tokens>0).sum()),'token_histogram':tokens.tolist(),'diagnostic_only':True,'fid_score':None,'gpu_used':False}),flush=True)
